## EventDef

EventDef configures one dynamic event and the rules CE uses to place, populate,
retain, and replenish its instances.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 15 |
| Additional properties | boolean schema=false |

### EventDef.name

Key: `name`

Path: [`event`](#eventsfileevent).`[]`.`name`

Name is the event identifier referenced by position and group data.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | yes |
| Examples | `AmbientFox` |

### EventDef.active

Key: `active`

Path: [`event`](#eventsfileevent).`[]`.`active`

Active enables or disables spawning for this event (`1` or `0`).

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `integer` |
| Required | no |
| Enum | `0`, `1` |
| Examples | `1` |

### EventDef.EventChildren

Key: `children`

Path: [`event`](#eventsfileevent).`[]`.`children`

Children define the entity classes or objects created by this event and any
per-child count or loot limits.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Required | no |
| Reference | [`EventChildren`](#eventchildren) (`#/$defs/EventChildren`) |

### EventDef.cleanupradius

Key: `cleanupradius`

Path: [`event`](#eventsfileevent).`[]`.`cleanupradius`

CleanupRadius controls when an event zone may clean up its spawned entities.
Ambient zones remain active while a player is within this radius.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `integer` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `120` |

### EventDef.distanceradius

Key: `distanceradius`

Path: [`event`](#eventsfileevent).`[]`.`distanceradius`

DistanceRadius controls the distance condition for placing event instances. For
ambient zone events, it is the player distance at which a zone becomes eligible
to spawn its entities.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `integer` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `80` |

### EventDef.EventFlags

Key: `flags`

Path: [`event`](#eventsfileevent).`[]`.`flags`

Flags control event cleanup and initial-spawn behavior.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Required | no |
| Reference | [`EventFlags`](#eventflags) (`#/$defs/EventFlags`) |

### EventDef.lifetime

Key: `lifetime`

Path: [`event`](#eventsfileevent).`[]`.`lifetime`

Lifetime is how long an event instance may remain active before it expires, in
seconds. Entity lifetime may also be controlled by its type entry.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `integer` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `33` |

### EventDef.limit

Key: `limit`

Path: [`event`](#eventsfileevent).`[]`.`limit`

Limit selects how Min and Max apply to the child entries and their combined
event count.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `mixed` |

### EventDef.max

Key: `max`

Path: [`event`](#eventsfileevent).`[]`.`max`

Max is the upper event count bound used by the selected Limit mode.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `integer` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `25` |

### EventDef.min

Key: `min`

Path: [`event`](#eventsfileevent).`[]`.`min`

Min is the lower event count bound used by the selected Limit mode.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `integer` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `0` |

### EventDef.nominal

Key: `nominal`

Path: [`event`](#eventsfileevent).`[]`.`nominal`

Nominal is the target number of active instances CE tries to maintain for this
event.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `integer` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `0` |

### EventDef.position

Key: `position`

Path: [`event`](#eventsfileevent).`[]`.`position`

Position selects how CE chooses event locations, for example from fixed mission
positions or from a generated distribution.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `fixed` |

### EventDef.restock

Key: `restock`

Path: [`event`](#eventsfileevent).`[]`.`restock`

Restock is the delay, in seconds, before CE may create a replacement event
instance.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `integer` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `25` |

### EventDef.saferadius

Key: `saferadius`

Path: [`event`](#eventsfileevent).`[]`.`saferadius`

SafeRadius is the minimum clearance used by CE's event placement rules.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `integer` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `0` |

### EventDef.secondary

Key: `secondary`

Path: [`event`](#eventsfileevent).`[]`.`secondary`

Secondary names an additional event CE may spawn for each instance, such as the
infected event paired with a crash site or convoy.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `InfectedArmyDesert` |
